reviews.title: Recovery for ADHD
reviews.text: I love this app so much! But the truth is, I’ve had it for so long and wasn’t utilizing all the amazing tools it actually has. Not only am I a recovering alcoholic addict, I have ADHD and it’s really hard for me to stay consistent and organized. I just upgraded to the premium package. I just noticed I can get reminders to do my inventories gratitude list and so on. Thank you for making this user-friendly.

reviews.title: Great recovery app
reviews.text: This app has all the tools needed to work on your recovery if you’re working a twelve step program. It even has some of the prayers from the AA book on there. Also, the owner of the app (I think he’s the owner), Nathan, has been very helpful with some things regarding the app. I use this app daily & I love it!

reviews.title: Emotional Sobriety
reviews.text: This app has opened up so much emotional sobriety for me. The beautifully simple invitation to actually do inventories and gratitudes has so enhanced my life and relationships that I am as grateful for this app as I am for AA.  I am in awe of each for how they have enhanced my life in ways I never knew about or expected.  Heartfelt gratitude to Nathan who developed this app.  I thank you, and my wife, children and grandchildren would all thank you if they knew how much of who I have become was made possible by your seemingly simple but profound spiritual toolkit. (Thanks also to my sponsor who recommended this app to me.)

reviews.title: I stayed for the miracle
reviews.text: This is my 4th time getting sober and I finally got this time why cuz I got out of my own way. My sponsor showed me this app and let’s face it 21st century the phone is always with us. My mom told me the phone is always with you why not use its full potential. This app is truly the greatest thing that was made and helps me tremendously because of everything that is in this app. Trust me if I can do it so can you but what you put into this is truly what you get out. Thanks for letting me share I am Niko and I truly am a grateful recovering addict

This app isn't reliable for my needs.
